column3: “Rising early and speaking” is rendered “again and again.”
“Rising early and sending” is rendered “again and again.”
“Fetch” is rendered “take,” and “to Nebuchadnezzar” as “I will send to Nebuchadnezzar.”
“Work by them” is rendered “make slaves of them”; NASB puts the verse in parentheses.
“Cut off at the corner” is rendered “cut the corners of their hair.”
“The Arabs” is rendered “the foreign people”; the two Hebrew words look alike.
“Sheshach” is kept as a name (a cipher for Babylon).
“Exempt from punishment” is rendered “free from punishment.”
